description: Type context-window overflows. The spec only declares a generic 400 (ErrorResponse) on this operation, but an input that does not fit the model context window is a distinct, non-retryable failure the caller usually handles (truncate and resend). The wire: 400 {"error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","param":"input","code":"context_length_exceeded"}} — observed live on POST /responses (gpt-4o-mini, ~160k tokens, 2026-10-05); chat/completions/embeddings return the same code per the OpenAI error-codes guide. Matched on the body pointer /error/code, which beats the status-only BadRequest matcher.
